issue.message: The loading and failed-load markup every screen shows is repeated in each screen instead of written once. Fix: Write the loading and failed-load markup once as one component or function in components or blocks and use it on every screen instead of repeating the Paragraph plus Try again block in each file.

entries.reason: Added one PageState component in web/app/components/PageState and used it for every loading and failed-load block on all screens.

issue.message: OrderDate and stockTag are exported but never used. Fix: Remove the unused OrderDate and stockTag exports or use them where stock and dates are shown.

entries.reason: Removed the unused OrderDate and stockTag exports from web/app/blocks/orders/OrderItems.tsx.

issue.message: isSoldOut is exported but never used. Fix: Remove the unused isSoldOut export or use it where sold-out is decided.

entries.reason: PieceCards now decides sold-out through isSoldOut instead of its own total check.

issue.message: changePassword writes the plaintext password to persistent browser storage. Fix: Do not persist the password in the persistent store or any browser storage and never show it back; keep only the session and handle the password change without storing the secret.

entries.reason: Removed passwords from the persistent auth store; changePassword validates the session and stores nothing anywhere.

issue.message: Records are read through async functions instead of through the operation hooks. Fix: Read records only through the entity layer hooks such as useLookupOrder and useListOrders instead of calling the lookupOrder and listOrders functions directly.

entries.reason: Order lookup reads through useLookupOrder and checkout references read through useListOrders; the direct lookupOrder and listOrders calls are gone.

issue.message: S03 step 1 requires photos, title, description, price and category but the page never shows the category. Fix: Show the piece category (FD05) by its label beside the title, description and price.

entries.reason: S03 now shows the piece category label in a Tag beside the description and price.

issue.message: S01 hero media builds piece preview by hand with Card without photo, category or link instead of a CardList of piece cards. Fix: Render the hero media preview from PieceCards/CardList with photo, title link, price, category and stock/sold-out for up to 3 in-stock pieces.

entries.reason: The hero media now renders PieceCards with photo, title link, price, category and stock for up to 3 in-stock pieces, and the separate featured section is gone.

issue.message: Glaze-and-size variants show the raw size key small/medium/large instead of its Small/Medium/Large label. Fix: Map every displayed size key through SizeOptions labels so it reads Small, Medium or Large in S03, S04, S06, S10, S11 and S13.

entries.reason: Every displayed size key now goes through SizeOptions labels via sizeLabel in S03, S04, S05 messages, OrderItems, S10, S11 and S13.

issue.message: S20 password edit adds a second labeled field with help text and a Done button under the record instead of an in-place edit. Fix: Edit the password in place with no label and no help text and icon edit/save/cancel buttons beside the value, or in a dialog.

entries.reason: S20 now edits the password in place with icon edit/save/cancel buttons beside a masked value and no label, help text or Done button.

issue.message: No screen uses Truncate for one-line text such as titles, cells, breadcrumbs or status lines. Fix: Wrap every text meant for one line in Truncate so it cuts with ellipsis and tooltip instead of wrapping or overflowing.

entries.reason: Wrapped one-line record titles and buyer names in Truncate on PieceCards and in the S04, S10, S11, S15 and S17 tables.

issue.message: changePassword writes the plaintext password into persistent browser storage. Fix: Do not persist the password: remove `passwords` from the persistent store and keep nothing secret in browser storage, logs, URLs, or UI.

entries.reason: Same fix as T10: no passwords key remains in the persistent store and changePassword keeps no secret in storage, logs, URLs or UI.

issue.message: Checkout decrements each piece's stock then creates the order with no atomicity, leaving partial stock loss when a later step fails. Fix: Make stock decrements and order creation atomic in one entity operation with rollback, or restore any decremented stock and tell the user exactly what was and was not saved.

entries.reason: Added the atomic createOrderWithStock entity operation with rollback, and checkout reports exactly what failed and that nothing was saved.

issue.message: Cancel restores stock piece-by-piece then cancels with no guard or atomicity, so failure or a second press can double-restore stock while reporting unchanged. Fix: Make stock restore plus cancellation a single atomic operation with a running guard so a second press does nothing, and report exactly what failed without claiming the order is unchanged after partial restores.

entries.reason: Added the atomic cancelOrderWithRestore entity operation with a busy guard, and failures report the reason with the order unchanged.

issue.message: Percentage discounts stay fractional so separately rounded shown discount and total can differ by ₹1. Fix: Round the discount to whole rupees once (e.g. Math.round) before computing shipping and total so the shown total equals shown subtotal minus shown discount plus shown shipping.

entries.reason: discountFor now rounds the discount to whole rupees before shipping and total are computed.

issue.message: Mark paid, advance, cancel, deactivate and remove run without a running guard so a second press re-runs the operation. Fix: Disable each mutating button while its operation runs so a second press while it runs does nothing, as done for form submits.

entries.reason: Mark paid, advance, cancel, deactivate and remove buttons now disable with loadingWithReason while their operation runs.

issue.message: S01 hero preview filters to in-stock pieces only, so the sold-out featured piece from step 4 can never appear. Fix: Show the first three pieces including sold-out pieces in the hero preview so the Sage Green sold-out card appears with its sold-out state.

entries.reason: The S01 hero preview now shows the first three pieces including sold-out ones; the empty state shows only when there are no pieces at all.

issue.message: S06 shows the fulfilment status raw key for every status except New instead of its readable label. Fix: Render the fulfilment status by its label (New, Packed, Shipped, Picked Up, Cancelled) instead of the stored key.

entries.reason: S06 now renders the fulfilment status through FulfilmentStatusOptions labels instead of the stored key.

issue.message: S20 alternative for a visitor not signed in is not built and the page renders an empty email while the session loads. Fix: When there is no signed-in owner show a Sign in link to /sign-in, and show nothing while the saved session is still being read.

entries.reason: S20 returns nothing while the session is being read and shows a Sign in link to /sign-in when there is no signed-in owner.

issue.message: Cancelling restores stock by matching piece title and silently skips missing or renamed pieces, leaving stock inconsistent. Fix: Restore cancelled stock by the ordered piece's id (persisted on the order) and, when a variant or piece cannot be restored, leave the order unchanged or tell the user what was not restored instead of silently skipping it.

entries.reason: Orders now persist itemPieceId, cancel restores stock matched by piece id, and lines whose piece or variant is gone are reported in a warning toast instead of silently skipped.
